DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_NightBlueHorse:
It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane.
If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. 
Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids <characterName id=|BlueThunderHorse|/> at all costs.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_NightBlueHorse:
Can be ridden. 
Boosts jumping ability while mounted.

This Pal's movement speed increases by <Status_Up>+{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</> at night.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
